constitution.historical_archival: archival changes custody only, not truth
constitution.historical_auditability: every historical artifact remains independently auditable

constitution.historical_reconciliation: contradictions are preserved and reconciled through explicit correction
constitution.historical_replay: replays history without creating new source truth
constitution.historical_restoration: restores original identity and lineage from immutable evidence
